scope: experimental conditional readout gate; no default change or physiological calibration

referenceBank.placement: two centers per axis, unit chart coordinates .25 and .75
referenceBank.router: nearest squared Euclidean distance in normalized candidate chart; smallest index breaks ties

sources.use: Canonical component modes 5 and 15 seconds and undershoot area ratio 1/6 anchor the proposal; selected bounds are our declared sensitivity envelope, not SPM defaults or empirical population quantiles.

stopRule: Run the frozen proposal once. Retain failures. Do not narrow the domain, add references, increase correction count or retune placement after observing the fresh cohort.
